description: Fetch one concept entry by slug: title, category, level, tags and the editor's summary. Written by a named human editor, not generated. `level` is GRADED on every active row since 2026-09-18 (the CHECK constraint accepted only the legacy vocabulary OR NULL, so the loader wrote NULL rather than fail; 108 of 330 were blank). A null, if one ever returns, means 'not graded', never 'Beginner'. The card body, cheat sheet, glossary, pro tip and the four analysis tables are subscriber content and are NOT returned. Why-it-matters and key points are not returned here either, but they ARE published in full on the concept page at citation_url — follow the URL for those.
name: get_concept
title: Concept metadata and editor's summary (public)
